prompt:
Extract a SysML v2 model from the document as a list of facts. Each fact has unit_id (the sentence it comes from), type and slots. Give only the slots that have a value, as a list of {slot, value} pairs; for composition give one 'parts' pair per part.

Types and slots:
  attribute(owner,name,value,unit) action(performer,label) state(owner,label) constraint(subject,expression) requirement(subject,text)
  composition(whole,parts) flow(source,target,payload) succession(before,after) transition(from,to,trigger) allocation(action,to)

Name each element by its full name as first introduced in the document.
RULES:
- Resolve every entity-valued slot using all the text you are given. If a sentence refers to an element by an alias, abbreviation, pronoun or shorter description, write the element's full name as first introduced. If a sentence says an element receives or uses an item and the text you are given states which element produces or sends that item, emit a flow from that producer to the receiver. If an element cannot be determined from the text you are given, use null; never guess.
- Never write placeholder words such as "any", "all", "some state" for an unstated element; use null.
- Do not merge differently named things unless the text says they are the same.
- Emit one action for EVERY behavior verb phrase, including passive voice (performer null), capability statements, displays, logs, generates and reports. label = the verbatim verb phrase with its object.
- Emit a requirement for every NORMATIVE statement (shall, must, should, will, is required to, needs to). Purpose, goal or benefit sentences are not requirements.
- Emit a state for every named mode or state; transitions use the state names, with from null when the prior state is not stated.
- Emit a succession only for an EXPLICIT temporal connective between two actions ("then", "after", "once", "before", "when ... is complete", "next", "finally"); before/after are the action labels. Never use succession for cause or data transfer.
- Resolve a pronoun or "this/these" performer to the element named in the preceding sentence and write that element's name; if it cannot be resolved, use null. Never output a pronoun as a slot value.
- Drop determiners and quantifiers from element names ("Each Soil Moisture Probe" -> "Soil Moisture Probe", "the system" -> "system").
- allocation.to must be a component or actor, never a mode or state.
- Emit a constraint for every threshold, limit, period or deadline stated with a number; expression = the verbatim phrase.
- Emit a flow for every sentence in which an element sends, transmits, reports, displays, commands or delivers an item (target null if the receiver is not named).
 Also list under "entities" every system element, actor or item named in the document units, with its full name and any alias the text explicitly declares for it (e.g. 'hereafter X', 'known as X', 'called X'); aliases [] if none. Return JSON {"entities": [...], "facts": [...]}.

Memory from EARLIER parts of the document (do not extract facts from it; use it only to resolve names, aliases and who produces an item):
Caldera Wildfire Detection and Suppression Support System: advisory WUI decision support; favors command continuity over automation when comms/power/sensors impaired; audits all assignment/staging changes. Elements: Caldera Incident Command Portal (Emberhall): triages above-threshold cases with reasons; marks radio route impaired on bridge failure (Orion ack); jurisdiction constraints before Drone Pilot Operator briefing; produces Crew Staging Pin (effective time, accuracy, incident ID); promotes accepted fire location to Redtail; records assignment packages (objective, validity, acks); flags assignments if Confirmed Ignition State changes perimeter/priority; extended attack mode preserves aviation decisions; disconnected operating mode: last-sync marking, cached review, queued updates, no irreversible releases. Airspace Restricted State: helitack assignments show boundary, need confirmation before aircraft-dependent movement. North/South Lookout Camera Masts: North sends smoke bearing, Thermal Spot Snippet to Orion; South triangulation bearing, Camera Cleaning Log to Smoke Classifier. Horizon Ridge Drone Dock (Kestrel): Battery Swap Ticket to Drone Pilot Operator; readiness/health; availability-only, no crew movement authority. Drone Tasking Service: missions, task status (pending/active/complete); not flight-release authority; no Marigold lane conflict. Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine (Lantern): traceable recommendations; score not fire declaration; perimeter, probability bands, hazards; applies Ridge Shadow Mask; crew exposure refresh only with valid recon confidence and weather timing; keeps last approved model on repository outage, rejects unversioned/unsigned packages. Smoke Classifier Module: plume confidence to Lantern; produces Ridge Shadow Mask; never sole aircraft basis. MesoWest Weather Fusion Node (Brindle): Wind Shift Bulletin to Redtail; staging exposure flags. VHF Radio Gateway Repeater (Badger): fallback relay, mirrors priority assignment summaries. Crewline Mobile Tablet: objectives, hazards (snags, access, slope, utilities, escape routes), route, rally point, channel; caches staging; hides expired packages; degraded link shows last verified package with time; no scores. Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console (Marigold): blocks release if approvals/airspace/readiness incomplete; Runway Release Note; Suppression Drop Receipt. East/West Retardant Loading Pumps: state reports; East sends Retardant Batch Slip to Tanker Base Manager. Actors: County Emergency Liaison (Drone Corridor Permit; view-only); Duty Detection Officer (Orion; stale-data warnings); Air Attack Supervisor

Document units:
S181: The Smoke Classifier Module shall label detections as advisory when either camera mast is unavailable or when image quality falls below the validated threshold.
S182: The North Lookout Camera Mast and the South Lookout Camera Mast shall report heartbeat, temperature, storage, and pointing-status telemetry so that maintenance staff can distinguish sensor failure from environmental obscuration.
S183: The MesoWest Weather Fusion Node shall retain a local weather cache sufficient to support near-term fire behavior review when upstream feeds are intermittent.
S184: Crewline Mobile Tablet clients shall queue field updates locally, encrypt the queue at rest, and reconcile conflicts by preserving the original author, device time, and server acceptance time.
S185: All interactive access to the Caldera Incident Command Portal requires named accounts, role-based authorization, and multifactor authentication when the authentication service is reachable.
S186: When the authentication service is unreachable, emergency access uses pre-issued signed credentials that expire automatically and require supervisor review after restoration.
S187: The Air Attack Supervisor, Tanker Base Manager, Helitack Crew Leader, Drone Pilot Operator, and County Emergency Liaison receive only the permissions required for their operational responsibilities.
S188: Administrative privileges for production configuration changes require separate approval from operational command roles and are not granted through field user accounts.
S189: Security-relevant events, including failed logons, role changes, queued update releases, model changes, and maintenance overrides, shall be written to an append-only audit store.
S190: Audit records shall include synchronized time, user identity, device identity, source network, affected record, and outcome so that incident reconstruction remains possible after the event.
S191: If central audit storage is unavailable, each field component shall buffer signed audit records locally and forward them without modification when connectivity returns.
S192: Drone Tasking Service validates the corridor permit before releasing an automated flight task in degraded communications mode.
S193: Badger shall queue outbound voice-to-data acknowledgments for at least fifteen minutes during backhaul loss and forward them when the link is restored.
S194: East Retardant Loading Pump shall enter a metered recirculation mode when pressure variance exceeds the calibrated maintenance limit.
S195: The West Retardant Loading Pump shall be inspected at shift change for hose wear, valve position, controller alarms, and leakage before it is returned to operational availability.
S196: Maintenance actions on field equipment shall be recorded with technician identity, time, observed condition, corrective action, and verification result before the equipment status is changed.
